description: Fill the selection (or the whole layer when nothing is selected) on the active layer with the foreground or background colour, black, 50% gray, white, a pattern, a History state, or Content-Aware fill (Edit > Fill). A pattern fill can run one of the scripted patterns Photoshop ships (Edit > Fill > Pattern > Script: Brick Fill, Cross Weave, Place Along Path, Random Fill, Symmetry Fill) with its settings given here instead of in its dialog. Content-Aware needs a selection and fills it directly, without the Content-Aware Fill workspace. For a specific colour use fill_selection

colorAdaptation.description: Content-Aware: blend the fill's colour with its surroundings. Default true

contents.description: What to fill with; gray is 50% gray

historyIndex.description: History state to fill from (list_history), for contents history. Default 0, the opening state

mirror.description: Content-Aware: allow mirrored samples. Default false

pattern.description: Pattern name (from the Patterns panel), for contents pattern

preserveTransparency.description: Leave transparent pixels transparent. Default false

rotationAdaptation.description: Content-Aware: allow rotated samples. Default false

scale.description: Content-Aware: allow scaled samples. Default false

script.description: Contents pattern: lay the pattern out with this scripted pattern (the Script option)

scriptOptions.description: With script: the script's settings; any left out keep the script's defaults, and values beyond what the script allows are clamped. brick_fill: patternScale, spacing, offset, colorRandomness, brightnessRandomness, rotateAngle; cross_weave: patternScale, spacing, colorRandomness, brightnessRandomness; place_along_path: patternScale, spacing, addSpaceToFit, angleFromPath, distanceFromPath, alternate, scaleAlong, skipRotation, colorRandomness, brightnessRandomness; random_fill: density, patternScaleFrom, patternScaleTo, maxDistanceFromPath, applyRotation, colorRandomness, brightnessRandomness; symmetry_fill: symmetryType, patternScale, patternTranslationX, patternTranslationY, colorRandomness, brightnessRandomness. Scales and randomness are fractions (1 = 100%), spacing and distances pixels, angles degrees, symmetryType 0-32 as listed in the Symmetry Fill dialog

scriptPath.description: With script place_along_path (required) or random_fill: the path in the Paths panel to place the pattern along

name: fill_contents
title: Fill Contents
